ja: • 戦術音楽ユニット「ワルキューレ」のリーダー、カナメ・バッカニアの特徴的なコサージュも髪のハネと共に再現！
• アニメならではの瞳の色分けを精密に設計し、1パーツに4色をイサート成形。シールなしの成型色で、目をフルカラー再現！
• 合計10色の成形品と一部マーキングシールにより、パーツを組み合わせるだけで色鮮やかな完成品フィギュアと変わらないクオリティを再現!!
en: • The characteristic corsage of Kaname Buccaneer, the leader of the tactical music unit "Valkyrie", is also recreated along with the bouncy hair!
• The eye color coding unique to anime has been precisely designed, and four colors are insert molded into one part. Full color reproduction of eyes with molded color without seal!
• With molded parts in a total of 10 colors and some marking seals, you can reproduce the same quality as a brightly colored finished figure just by combining the parts!!
